description: Turns pay as you go off for the workspace, at once: no new pay-as-you-go work starts. Work already approved is still charged at its price, and live sites and fixed prices are not affected. Turning it on again needs the person's approval (turn_on_pay_as_you_go). Only owners and admins can. Confirm with the person before you call.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: turn_off_pay_as_you_go
title: Turn off pay as you go
